Both "failures" are errors in MY test expectations, not the implementation:

1. "discard drops pending": I expected keys H="absent" but the implementation gives H="discarded" — the implementation is right (the key event discards H). My expectation was wrong.

2. "error no pn mark": after the first packet errors, the connection is closed, so the second packet is dropped CONNECTION_CLOSED. My test expectation was wrong (I forgot the connection closes on error). The implementation is right.

Let me fix these test expectations and re-run.
